about: The collecta of the formulary “Second Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who by the humility of Thy Son didst raise up the fallen world, grant everlasting gladness to Thy faithful, that those whom Thou hast rescued from the perils of everlasting death may enjoy joys without end. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
